description: A flexible, production-ready Clean Architecture template for .NET with optional Aspire orchestration, CQRS, DDD, multiple database providers (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite), optional JWT Authentication, front-end options (React, Angular, Blazor), Health Checks, OpenTelemetry, Serilog, Docker Compose, Azure deployment, and comprehensive testing. Configure your ideal setup via the wizard.
title: Clean Architecture Template with Aspire
